description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing an OTP verification screen, including UI components such as header banner, OTP input field, verification button, and debug bypass functionality. It also handles user interaction, OTP validation, and navigation to the home activity upon success or debug bypass.

classes.name: OTPSecondScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the OTP verification screen, which accepts a mobile number to verify via OTP.

classes.name: _OTPSecondScreenState
classes.description: State class for OTPSecondScreen handling UI state, user interactions, OTP validation, and navigation.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap on the 'Continue' button; triggers OTP verification or debug bypass based on tap count.

methods.name: _bypassOTPForTesting
methods.description: Debug-only method to bypass OTP verification, sets login flags, shows snack bar, and navigates to home.

methods.name: _verifyOTP
methods.description: Performs OTP validation and, upon success, updates preferences and navigates to the home activity.
